new: Triangles ADB and BDC are similar, so BD² = AD × DC: x(x + 7) = 144, so x² + 7x − 144 = (x + 16)(x − 9) = 0 and x = 9. Then AC = 25 and AB² = AD × AC = 225, so AB = 15 cm.
